authorization: Server configuration allowlists knowledge_base_id and maps source_instance/source_id to allowed source_scope strings. Every publication/member/search hit is checked independently against that mapping. A caller-supplied source_scope never grants permission.

source_scope.description: Configured dataset/business scope label, e.g. pipeline_landscape, research_frontier, commercial_metrics, public_health. May be any explicitly configured string; source mapping is authoritative.

raw_locator.description: Opaque Fabric fixed-version locator. Never fetched by WeKnora; identity fields must equal publication identity. uri max 1000 chars.

request.title: string, 1..500 characters; original retained in receipt/features, native display title limited to 255
request.content_sha256: optional 64 hex; verified against UTF-8 content

response.knowledge_id: string or null before upload recovered
response.indexed_text_sha256: hash of actual uploaded text including version marker
response.graph_status: not_requested; reviewed graph pipeline remains separate
response.display_title_truncated: boolean; only the native display column is truncated

GET /api/v1/kdd/publications/{publicatio.response: same publication receipt; reads current upstream state and actual vector rows

POST /api/v1/kdd/publications/{publicati.response: publication receipt, source_status disabled, disable_reason, index exclusion verified from read-only storage

request.members: 1..100 identity objects; optional knowledge_id, all fixed version identity fields required

response.scope_fingerprint: sha256 of fixed members and scope

embedding_provenance.model_version: model configuration revision (no claimed weights version)

response.excluded: list of member+reason, no silent omissions
response.statistical_unit: document_version; independent studies/projects require Radar mapping

response.execution: actual keyword/vector/embedding/rerank executed states, safe model descriptors, index version, degraded bool and degraded_reasons

errors.409: same fixed version has different raw/content hash, unknown upload awaiting reconciliation, or concurrent operation
errors.502: upstream API/model failure; never empty success
errors.503: vector store unavailable; status/features report explicit degradation when safely possible

notes: New versions create distinct index documents; prior versions remain fixed until explicitly disabled/superseded.
Source identity binds chunks via their knowledge foreign key; API exposes it on each returned chunk.
No Fabric database writes; index mutations only via existing WeKnora HTTP APIs; vector SQL uses read-only transactions.
Initial bounded verification uses a new KDD KB with BAAI/bge-m3 1024; no full-corpus reindex.

While parse is pending/processing/finalizing, binding remains pending. Replay the same publication after parse completed to finalize the native metadata projection without re-uploading. A missing projection is not an explicit revocation.
publication_id_formula: sha256(json.dumps([knowledge_base_id, source_instance, source_id, source_record_id, version_id], ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
revoked_source_cleanup: Authenticated service may read content-free receipts and disable only already registered publication IDs after source mapping revocation. Features and search always require the current mapping.
